title: SoroBeacon — Alert Delivery & Dead-Letter Queue
description: Diagnostic view answering which channels are failing, what the dead-letter backlog is, and whether SSE subscribers or throttles are dropping notifications.

panels.title: Alerts Fired vs Deliveries Completed
panels.description: Good: delivery rate tracks alerts fired closely. Divergence indicates throttling, digest buffering, or channel failures.

panels.title: Failing Deliveries by Channel Type
panels.description: Good: 0 errors/sec. Identifies which channel types are experiencing downstream endpoint failures.

panels.title: Dead-Letter Queue Backlog
panels.description: Good: 0 items waiting in DLQ. Rising backlog requires operator inspection and re-drive via the Dead Letters API.

panels.title: Throttled Deliveries by Channel Type
panels.description: Good: near 0 during normal operations. High values mean per-channel rate limits are actively protecting downstream endpoints.

panels.title: Live SSE Stream Dropped Events
panels.description: Good: 0 dropped events. Non-zero rate means a connected SSE client is reading too slowly to keep up with alert bursts.
